sections.title: Parallel Worktrees — Run Two Sessions Simultaneously
sections.description: The most powerful pattern: each session works on its own branch with no file conflicts.
sections.code:
# Create isolated worktrees for two independent features
git worktree add ../my-app-feature-auth     -b feature/auth
git worktree add ../my-app-feature-billing  -b feature/billing

# Open a terminal in each and start Claude Code
cd ../my-app-feature-auth    && claude
cd ../my-app-feature-billing && claude

# When done, clean up
git worktree remove ../my-app-feature-auth
git branch -d feature/auth

items.title: Tell Claude tasks are independent
items.body: Say 'Run these two tasks in parallel: 1. ... 2. ...' Claude will fire two Agent tool calls in the same message and synthesise results when both return.

items.title: Self-contained subagent briefs
items.body: Subagents start cold with no shared memory. Include file paths, function names, and exactly what format to return results in.

items.title: Read-only by default
items.body: For research subagents, specify 'read only, do not make any changes'. This keeps the exploration safe.
